args.script:
cat << 'EOF' > count_files.sh
#!/bin/bash
# Shell script to count total number of files in all subdirectories of test_directory

total=0

for subdir in test_directory/*/; do
    if [ -d "$subdir" ]; then
        count=$(find "$subdir" -type f | wc -l)
        total=$((total + count))
    fi
done

echo "Total number of files: $total"
EOF
chmod +x count_files.sh
